title: Review repair B: the read-only source grade is enforced by the issuer; settlement on TERM; docs and prompt claims
description:
BLOCKER from the final review (security, tests-docs and spec reviewers, independently): the read-only source grade issued to review-epic jobs only disables the supervisor's timed push (internal/exec/subprocess/supervisor.go:225-227 canPush); the runner is started with the operator's whole environment (supervisor.go:101 os.Environ) inside a linked worktree that shares the repository's remotes and git config, so a review job can 'git push' any ref with ambient ssh-agent/credential-helper credentials. contracts/job-protocol.json:268, internal/reconcile/doc.go:87, executor.go:484-486, dispatch.go:448-455, record.go:179-181, profiles/review-epic.md:5 and RESULT-cc5.md:27 all claim the issuer refuses the write. Also: the credential file is issued regardless of grade (executor.go:387-391, observation credential_issued for a read-only attempt); on SIGTERM/SIGINT the supervisor returns without writing runner.exit (supervisor.go:185) so a TERM'd attempt is 'lost' forever and re-refused on every restart; excludeFromGit (git.go:122) appends a permanent line to info/exclude that nothing removes; supervisor.pid and observations are written with '_ =' (executor.go:391,408; supervisor.go:108-118; cancel.go:47). Fix in internal/exec/subprocess: for a read-only grade launch the runner with git writes made impossible by construction — scrub credential-bearing env (SSH_AUTH_SOCK, GIT_ASKPASS, SSH_ASKPASS, GIT_SSH_COMMAND, *TOKEN*) and pin git config through GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n/VALUE_n so credential.helper is empty, core.askPass is false, and every remote's pushurl points at an unreachable value (e.g. remote.<name>.pushurl=/dev/null or an invalid URL), and prove with a test that 'git push' from inside a read-only attempt worktree fails while a write-grade attempt still pushes; issue no credential file for read-only; write a failed settlement (runner.exit or a stop marker inspect reads as settled) on the signal path; remove the exclude line on Dispose; read pid writes back / stop ignoring observe errors where the observation stream is the inspect cursor. Then correct every claim named above to what the code now keeps (doc.go:87 in internal/reconcile, record.go, executor.go, dispatch.go comments, profiles/review-epic.md, RESULT-cc5.md:27) — you own those doc lines for this wave; do not touch other reconcile logic (sibling repair A owns internal/reconcile code).

## How this fits
Wave 8 of epic qeu (final-review repairs), three tickets in parallel. You own: internal/exec/subprocess plus ONLY the listed doc/comment lines (internal/reconcile/doc.go:87 region, record.go, executor.go/dispatch.go comments, profiles/review-epic.md, RESULT-cc5.md:27) — sibling A owns internal/reconcile code; sibling C owns CI/runstate. The reviewer reports are at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-peterengelbrecht-Development-ticfac/1687f85b-9680-4c8b-ad98-ebe61eb3bfb3/scratchpad/review/findings-all.md (read-only, on this host). Integration commit 06a82eb57da464ebcea04d910fac4bfd02c227f9 on epic/qeu. The reconcile package takes ~10 minutes: run it with go test -short -timeout 45m and never in the background. Verify your base: git merge-base --is-ancestor 06a82eb57da464ebcea04d910fac4bfd02c227f9 HEAD.
